extras.textures: PBR 2048px: base color, roughness, metallic, normal (baked)
extras.real_size: concrete mixer truck (3 axles), approx. 8.5 x 2.5 x 3.8 m (L x W x H), drum diameter 2.2 m, wheel diameter 1.04 m
extras.notes: front faces -Y; the mixer drum 'cement-mixer_drum' is a separate object with its origin on the drum axis at the front bearing; it spins around its own tilted axis (direction (0.000, 0.983, 0.182) in Blender coordinates, i.e. local Y tilted 10.5 degrees up towards the rear); 6 wheels are separate objects with origin on the axle (rotate around local X to roll), the front wheels also steer around local Z; opaque tinted windows, no interior; no brand, no text

origin.detail: Built procedurally with Blender scripts. The scripts were written with the help of an AI coding assistant. No generative AI model produced the geometry or textures directly.
